text:
olivia: Quick smoke check for the webinar landing + launch post tomorrow. Need final SEO pass: keyword anchors, FAQ schema, redirect CSV, canonical rules, sitemap ping. Who can own each? :coffee:

ryan: I can do the redirect CSV + staging deploy. Share list of retired URLs you want 301'd.

jess: Ill handle FAQ schema + meta descriptions. Want 6 Qs that map to signup objections and 2 long answers for featured snippets.

emma: Ill do internal linking and the content map. We should add anchor text for these priority kws: "inference cost optimization", "low-latency LLM serving", "dedicated GPU inference".

olivia: Good. Retired URLs: /events/2024/old-bench -> /webinar/benchmarks-2026, /blog/latency-old -> /blog/inference-latency-guide. Ryan pls generate CSV like:
```csv
from,to,status
/events/2024/old-bench,/webinar/benchmarks-2026,301
/blog/latency-old,/blog/inference-latency-guide,301
```

ryan: Will push to netlify _redirects in staging and open a PR. Tagging @eng-platform if any rewrite rules needed.

jess: Draft FAQ schema snippet I'll drop in the PR. Example Qs:
- How much does Redwood inference cost per 1k tokens?
- Can I run Redwood Private in our VPC?
- What latency can I expect for short completions?

jess: Example JSON-LD I'll expand:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use Redwood Private in my VPC?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Redwood Private supports VPC and on-prem deployments with KMS integration and audit logs."}}]}
```

emma: Internal linking plan: add contextual links from "Cost engineering for inference" blog and the "Dedicated capacity announcement" to the webinar hub. Use natural anchor variations not exact-match spam. Also add a canonical from A/B variant pages to the hub.

olivia: Also: sitemap update + submit to Google Search Console after deploy. Who can run the sitemap ping?

emma: I can. After PR merges I'll run `curl https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=https://www.redwood.ai/sitemap.xml` and paste response.

seo-bot: Preflight scan queued. Issues found: 2 pages missing H1, 4 images without alt text, 1 redirect loop suspected. Full report: https://redwood.tools/seo/279012 (results in thread once ready).

ryan: Noted on the redirect loop. Ill check rewrite rules and broken chain.

jess: Meta descriptions: Ill add 150-160 char meta descriptions for hub and launch post. Suggest: "Benchmarks for LLM inference: latency, cost, and serving patterns from real workloads. Register for the webinar."

olivia: GTM params for paid + organic: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=email|organic, utm_campaign=benchmarks_q2. Ensure forms set hidden utm fields mapped to SFDC. Ryan can you QA form mapping?

ryan: Yup, will QA mapping and test lead flow to SFDC sandbox.

olivia: Timeline: PRs up by 18:00 PT, redirects live on staging by 19:00, final preflight at 09:30 PT tomorrow. If SEO bot clears, we go live.

emma: Quick note: add rel=prev/next on paginated blog series and ensure hreflang not set for single-language site to avoid confusion.

jess: PR opened: #1424 with JSON-LD + meta copy. Please review.

seo-bot: Reminder: seo preflight scheduled in 15 minutes. Will post results here. :robot_face:
